exact_pose_symmetry.reason: The keyed insertion shaft fixes yaw. FoundPose, collision checking, and insertion must retain the full-key pose without folding it by 180 degrees.

socket_pose_symmetry.reason: The keyed bore fixes yaw even though the outer socket body is approximately rotationally symmetric.

grasp_proposal_symmetry.scope: handle-contact proposal and coverage bookkeeping only
grasp_proposal_symmetry.validation_rule: A proposal transferred within a class is a new candidate. Re-evaluate declared contacts, the complete hand against the exact key, table clearance, Franka reachability, held-key transfer, and exact socket clearance before execution.
